models.purpose: Authoritative Decimal position, cash, fee, and additive-cost accounting.
assumptions: all fills are authoritative and idempotent
limitations: FIFO tax lots are deliberately not represented; independent reconciliation uses FIFO
dependencies: pinned fee schedule inputs shared by primary and direct reference fee calculations

models.purpose: Causality-safe partial fills with declared fidelity and queue uncertainty.
assumptions: F0 bars have no queue claim
limitations: paper/modelled fill evidence is not observed endogenous impact
signed G5 supports F1 fully-funded long-only spot with explicit slippage/impact estimates; no passive queue or derivative promotion

models.purpose: Regularized covariance for portfolio attribution; outputs are MODEL_ESTIMATE.
limitations: does not establish alpha or independent empirical evidence
